'''João Manuel Peixoto Ferreira''' ({{IPA|pt|ʒuˈɐ̃w̃ mɐnuˈɛl pɐjˈʃotu fɨˈʁejɾɐ}}; born 20 November 1978) is a Portuguese biologist and politician, serving as [[Member of the European Parliament]] for the [[Portuguese Communist Party]] (PCP); part of the [[European United Left–Nordic Green Left]], where he was a vice-chair from 7 February 2012 to 30 June 2014, since 2009.<ref name="JoaoFerreira">{{cite web |url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/96706/JOAO_FERREIRA_home.html |title=João FERREIRA |access-date=29 May 2014 |website=[[European Parliament]]}}</ref>

João Ferreira is a member of the [[Central Committee]] of the [[Portuguese Communist Party]], and a member of the [[Lisbon]] Municipal Council.
